description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for user profiles, including data models, command handling, validation, and the core logic for editing user details in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user profile updates, containing optional fields for username, email, password, bio, and image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request command encapsulating user data for editing user profile, implementing IRequest to return a UserEnvelope.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator ensuring the Command's User data is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user edit request: retrieves the current user, updates fields, hashes the password if provided, and persists changes.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the core logic for editing a user, including fetching current user, applying updates, handling password hashing, and returning the updated user envelope.
